data.exact_reserve_text: The prior year development of +GBP 0.495m is calculated from the Gross insurance ultimate contract outstanding claims provisions table on page 15, by comparing the 'Current estimate of ultimate claims' for the 2018 underwriting year (34,900) to its estimate from the previous diagonal ('One year later' for 2018: 34,405).

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year strengthening of GBP 0.495 million, calculated from the claims development triangle. This strengthening was primarily influenced by adverse development on the 2019 Typhoon Hagibis and material gross exposure to COVID-19 on the 2019 Year of Account, which increased uncertainty in an adverse direction.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is calculated from the gross claims development triangle as no explicit prior year movement note was found. The gross premium mix is based on the formal segmental analysis which consolidates all business under 'Reinsurance', reflecting the syndicate's nature as a quota share reinsurer, despite narrative text listing underlying classes of business.
